items.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
items.why: Quote covers MCP server for AI assistants only; no recording, transcription, summarizing or Zoom/Meet/Teams.

items.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
items.why: Quote supports api_key auth only; oauth2 and bearer_token not mentioned.

items.quote: Use **OAuth** if you’re building an app that other Fathom users will install so they can connect their own accounts.
items.why: Quote states OAuth is for apps other users install to connect their accounts.

items.quote: Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.
items.why: Quote says keys and webhooks are on all plans; generate key in settings.

items.quote: This documentation describes Fathom's REST API.
items.why: Title-like fragment; no endpoints, base URL, rate limits or SDKs.
Quote gives MCP URL, so existence holds; vendor-official status not stated.
